question: Why is Coulomb’s law applied directly only when charged bodies can be treated as point charges? Give reason.

options.A: Coulomb’s law applies directly only to large bodies because charge is uniformly distributed
options.B: Coulomb’s law cannot be used for point charges
options.C: A body can be treated as a point charge when its size is negligible compared with separation, so its charge may be regarded as concentrated at one point
options.D: Coulomb’s law applies directly only if the two bodies are conductors
